description: Waveshare ESP32-P4-Pico native composition with two HP cores, a separate LP core, 32 MB flash, and 32 MB PSRAM

firmware_generation.interrupts: 48 HP CLIC routes are bounded by the maintained P4 port
firmware_generation.dma: AHB-GDMA, AXI-GDMA, and VDMA domains remain distinct
firmware_generation.clock: esp-hal startup owns HP clocks, timer calibration, and cache split
firmware_generation.boot: ESP image metadata and the 0x10000 application offset are port-owned
